items.source: Creates a RevisionSort with ascending order for the revision number property, i.e. more recent revisions will come last.
items.translation: 创建一个RevisionSort，按修订号属性升序排列，即较新的修订将排在最后。

items.source: Creates a RevisionSort with descending order for the revision number property, i.e. more recent revisions will come first.
items.translation: 创建一个RevisionSort，按修订号属性降序排列，即最近的修订将排在前面。

items.source: Returns in which direction to sort revisions for the given Sort instance. Defaults to Sort.Direction.ASC.
items.translation: 返回给定 Sort 实例的修订版排序方向。默认为 Sort.Direction.ASC。

items.source: A dedicated Sort implementation that allows the definition of the ordering of revisions independently of the property name the revision number is held in.
items.translation: 一个专用的Sort实现，它允许独立于存储修订号的属性名称来定义修订的排序顺序。

items.source: Returns in which direction to sort revisions for the given Sort instance.
items.translation: 返回给定Sort实例的排序方向。
